why_this_file: The reverse read — what the traded price must believe — is a DIAGNOSTIC and lives outside the numbers file every builder reads. A quantity solved from a price and then used anywhere in the valuation is the reverse-engineered rate the protocol prohibits outright, arriving through a side door. Nothing here is an input to anything; it is written OUT of what compute.py already committed.

implied.quantity: the gross margin sustained in every forecast year AND in perpetuity that reproduces the traded price
implied.solved_on: compute.py's own solve, holding every other driver at its base case and moving only the gross margin until the cash-flow lens reaches the market price
implied.reading: At EGP 13.50 the price is paying for a gross margin of 10.58% held in every forecast year and in perpetuity, against a base year of 9.65% — 93 basis points ABOVE it. That is INSIDE the range this company has actually printed: it filed 13.84% for the full year to 30 June 2022 and 13.92% in the quarter to 30 June 2026. So the market is not pricing something the business has never done; it is pricing a margin above the base year and below the best the company has filed, and the study's answer of EGP 11.40 is -15.5% against the price.

also_solved.quantity: the single flat discount rate that reproduces the traded price on this study's own free cash flows, terminal and bridge
also_solved.times_resolved: recovered from the study's own factors
also_solved.reading: The price is paying for a flat 17.47% on the same cash flows this study discounts at a schedule worth a flat 19.81%: a disagreement of 234 basis points on the price of time, against an explicit-window rate of 27.45% gliding to a terminal 18.14%. Read as a margin instead, the same gap is 93 basis points of gross margin, and THAT is the form a reader can check against the filed accounts.
